# Title Bank

Fill-in-the-blank title shapes for Billy's audience (the expert business owner using AI to make content without the slop). Each heading IS the template. One template, one pattern. Worked examples come from the [[pattern-bank]] outlier set. Loaded by `vid-title`.

This file is both the research output and Billy's curated set. Edit in place: delete shapes that don't sound like you, reword the slots, add winners over time.

## How to read this bank

Each heading is a STRUCTURE, not a phrase. The `[SLOTS]` get filled with your actual content. Spread (how many of the 11 analyzed channels used the pattern) and the channels show repeatability. No confidence rank: the spread is the signal. All nine below were kept in the Theory of One pass.

## Patterns

### `Why [common goal or identity] Is [a blunt negative judgment]`

- pattern_id: contrarian-identity
- spread: 2 of 11 channels (both direct)
- channels: [[@ed-lawrence]], [[@thisisnickys]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** it contradicts advice the audience hears everywhere, so the click is "wait, what?" This is the closest shape to Billy's whole positioning (against the grain, against the slop).

**Worked examples:**
- "Why Growing A Personal Brand Is An AWFUL Idea" → [[pattern-bank]] (@ed-lawrence, 115k)
- "Why Introverts Make the BEST Content Creators" (inverse: underdog wins) → [[pattern-bank]] (@thisisnickys, 137k)

**Near-miss:** "Why You Should Build A Personal Brand." Agrees with the default. No tension, no click.

**When not to use:** when you don't actually hold the contrarian position. A faked reversal collapses trust, which is the one thing this brand cannot spend.

### `DON'T [common practice]. [Do the better thing] Instead`

- pattern_id: contrarian-correction
- spread: 5 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@duncanrogoff]], [[@brockmesarich]], [[@nicksaraev]], [[@networkchuck]], [[@jeffsu]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** names a thing the viewer is probably doing, says it's wrong, and promises the fix. Variants: "You've Been [X] the Hard Way," "[%] STILL [X] Wrong."

**Worked examples:**
- "DON'T Sell AI Agents, Sell AI Micro-Apps Instead!" → [[pattern-bank]] (@duncanrogoff, 193k)
- "Stop Using Nano Banana Pro WRONG (Do This Instead)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@brockmesarich, 91k)
- "You've Been Using AI the Hard Way (Use This Instead)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@networkchuck, 2.1M)

**Near-miss:** "Stop Making These Mistakes." No specific practice named, no replacement promised.

**When not to use:** when you can't name the specific wrong thing AND the specific replacement. The pairing is the pattern.

### `I Built [specific outcome] (No Employees)`

- pattern_id: solo-leverage
- spread: 4 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@thisisnickys]], [[@sabrina_ramonov]], [[@davidondrej]], [[@nateherk]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** it's the avatar's exact dream stated as proof: do the work of a team without hiring one. Variants: "How to Start a 1-Person [business]," "I Replaced Myself with [tool]."

**Worked examples:**
- "I Built My Entire Content Team Inside Claude (No Employees)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@thisisnickys, 35k)
- "How To Start A 1-Person AI Business ($0 to $1M)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@sabrina_ramonov, 208k)

**Near-miss:** "How I Use AI For My Business." No leverage claim, no headcount tension.

**When not to use:** when the outcome is vague. "(No Employees)" only pays off against a concrete, normally-needs-a-team result.

### `[Tool] Just [Dropped / Changed] [your domain] Forever`

- pattern_id: news-jack-release
- spread: 5 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@ed-lawrence]], [[@brockmesarich]], [[@nicksaraev]], [[@sabrina_ramonov]], [[@nateherk]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** rides a fresh release the audience is already curious about, and ties it to their world. Pairs with the News format.

**Worked examples:**
- "Claude Just Changed Making YouTube Videos Forever" → [[pattern-bank]] (@ed-lawrence, 77k)
- "Anthropic Just Dropped Claude for Small Businesses (31 Skills)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@brockmesarich, 181k)
- "Claude Managed Agents Just Dropped, And It Kills n8n" → [[pattern-bank]] (@nicksaraev, 175k)

**Near-miss:** "A New AI Tool Was Released." No named tool, no stakes, no domain.

**When not to use:** when the release is stale by the time you publish. This shape decays fast; speed is the whole game.

### `[Outcome] in [N] Minutes` / `Master [%] of [X] in [N] Minutes`

- pattern_id: speed-mastery
- spread: 5 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@thisisnickys]], [[@brockmesarich]], [[@jeffsu]], [[@tinahuang1]], [[@davidondrej]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** specific outcome + a small time cost = low-risk click. The widest pattern in the whole build.

**Worked examples:**
- "Master 95% of Claude Design in 17 Minutes" → [[pattern-bank]] (@brockmesarich, 174k)
- "Learn 80% of Claude Cowork in Under 20 Minutes" → [[pattern-bank]] (@jeffsu, 1.0M)
- "How I Use VEO 3 To Create Viral AI Videos In 11 Minutes" → [[pattern-bank]] (@thisisnickys, 122k)

**Near-miss:** "Learn Claude Fast." No number, no time, no specific %.

**When not to use:** when the video can't actually deliver the outcome in the stated time. The promise has to be true.

### `How to [do X] Better Than 99% of People` / `[%] of People STILL [do X] Wrong`

- pattern_id: better-than-masses
- spread: 4 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@brockmesarich]], [[@duncanrogoff]], [[@jeffsu]], [[@sabrina_ramonov]]

- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** positions the viewer to join the elite minority (or escape the failing majority). Status hook.

**Worked examples:**
- "How to Use Claude Cowork Better Than 99% of People" → [[pattern-bank]] (@brockmesarich, 207k)
- "95% of People STILL Prompt ChatGPT-5 Wrong" → [[pattern-bank]] (@jeffsu, 635k)

**Near-miss:** "How to Use Claude Well." No comparison, no stakes.

**When not to use:** when you can't actually show the gap between the 99% and the 1%. The body has to earn the claim.

### `[Specific $] in [time period] (with [tool])` / `How [person] Makes [$X]/[period]`

- pattern_id: money-proof
- spread: 3 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@sabrina_ramonov]], [[@nicksaraev]], [[@thisisnickys]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** money is the single biggest driver for this audience. A specific dollar figure and timeframe is the strongest proof shape there is.

**Worked examples:**
- "4 Prompts I Gave Claude to Make $15,000 in 10 Days" → [[pattern-bank]] (@sabrina_ramonov, 114k)
- "How This Mom Makes $48K/Month With Claude" → [[pattern-bank]] (@sabrina_ramonov, 104k)
- "I Recreated Alex Hormozi's $6,000 AI for $33" → [[pattern-bank]] (@thisisnickys, 43k)

**Near-miss:** "Make Money With AI." No number, no timeframe, no proof. This is the slop version.

> [!warning] When not to use
> Only put a number on the thumbnail you can actually stand behind. Use Billy's real proof (the client he took from $340K to $1.3M, his own 0 to 100K). Never a fabricated AI-revenue claim like "I made $48K with Claude" when you didn't. A made-up money number is the exact slop this brand is built against, and it's the fastest way to lose the trust.

### `[N] [things] I Can't Live Without (steal them)` / `My [setup/assets] (steal my [X])`

- pattern_id: steal-these
- spread: 2 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@brockmesarich]], [[@tinahuang1]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** generosity hook. "Steal" signals you're handing over something real, not gatekeeping.

**Worked examples:**
- "15 Claude Cowork Skills I Can't Live Without (steal them)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@brockmesarich, 156k)
- "My FULL OpenClaw Setup (steal my prompts!)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@tinahuang1)

**Near-miss:** "My Favorite AI Tools." No generosity verb, no count, no take-it-now energy.

**When not to use:** when there's nothing concrete to actually hand over. "Steal" promises a deliverable.

### `The Only [X] You'll Ever Need`

- pattern_id: definitive-resource
- spread: 2 of 11 channels
- channels: [[@davidondrej]], [[@jeffsu]]
- own_channel_proven: false

**Why it lands:** promises to end the search. One video to rule the topic. Saves the viewer from the rabbit hole.

**Worked examples:**
- "The only AutoResearch tutorial you'll ever need" → [[pattern-bank]] (@davidondrej, 253k)
- "The Only AI Tools You Need (12-Minute Guide)" → [[pattern-bank]] (@jeffsu, 671k)

**Near-miss:** "A Guide To AI Tools." No finality, no relief.

**When not to use:** for a narrow or fast-changing topic where "only/ever" is obviously false.

## Considered + dropped

None dropped this build. The money-proof shape was kept active with the real-number guardrail (see its "When not to use"). Future refreshes archive dropped shapes here with rationale.

## Pattern combinations

Some shapes stack. Worked examples by pattern_id:

- `news-jack-release` + `contrarian-correction`: "Claude Managed Agents Just Dropped, And It Kills n8n" (@nicksaraev). A release tied to a "the old way is dead" correction.
- `speed-mastery` + `better-than-masses`: "Master 95% of Claude Design in 17 Minutes" (@brockmesarich). Speed promise carrying a mastery-vs-the-rest hook.
- `solo-leverage` + `money-proof`: "How To Start A 1-Person AI Business ($0 to $1M)" (@sabrina_ramonov). No-team leverage with a dollar arc.

## Field reference

- **Heading**: the template, backticked. `[SLOTS]` are the variables you fill.
- **pattern_id**: stable kebab slug. What `pattern-bank.md` studied rows link to.
- **spread**: `{N} of {M} channels`. Repeatability across the research set. No HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW label.
- **channels**: wikilinks to where the pattern appeared.
- **own_channel_proven**: whether proven on Billy's own channel. All false this build (no published videos on the new positioning yet).
- **Why it lands / Worked examples / Near-miss / When not to use**: the fit reason, real proof, the failure mode, the authenticity guard.
